Nafr
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
---- Respondent
20/01/2023 Mr. Amit Kumar Sharma, Counsel for the Applicant.
Mr. Anil Tripathi, P.L. for the State/respondent.
Heard on I.A. No. 01/2023, application for grant of ad-interim bail to the applicant.

The applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No. 51/2022 registered at Police Station- Mana Camp, District - Raipur, (C.G.) for commission of the offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station- Mana Camp, District - Raipur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Prosecution story in brief is that, it has been alleged by the complainant Smt. Nidhi Naag, Deputy Superintendent of Police that the applicant has fraudulently withdrawn salary to his account which was greater than the eligible pay scale and thus, committed the offence.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

He further submits that the applicant is a retired police personnel and has been framed in the instant case only because of his filing contempt case against the senior officials of the department for non-compliance of the order of this Court.
It is further submitted that the applicant is a senior citizen and there is no chance of his absconding, therefore, present applicant may be granted benefit of ad-interim bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the ad- interim bail application of the applicant.

Having heard counsel for the parties, considering all the facts and circumstances of this case and after going through this Court's order dated 11.04.2019 passed in WPS No. 2778 of 2019, I feel S.S. Thakur vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22300707/
1 inclined to allow this application.

entities.text: S.S. Thakur vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, application (I.A. No. 01/2023) for grant of ad-interim bail is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant, he shall be released on ad-interim bail on his furnishing a personal bond in sum of Rs.25,000/- with one local surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the arresting/Investigating Officer concerned or the trial Court concerned, till the final disposal of the present case.

In the meanwhile, case-diary be called and reply be filed by the learned State counsel.
List this case for final hearing in due course.

Sd/-
(Rajani Dubey) Judge Ruchi S.S. Thakur vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22300707/
